verses.literal: Moreover, the word of the LORD came to me saying
verses.literalPt: E VEIO a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:

verses.original: בֶּן־ אָדָ֕ם שִׂ֥ים פָּנֶ֖יךָ עַל־ הַ֣ר שֵׂעִ֑יר וְהִנָּבֵ֖א עָלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ben- ’ā·ḏām śîm pā·ne·ḵā ‘al- har śê·‘îr wə·hin·nā·ḇê ‘ā·lāw
verses.literal: Son of man set your face against Mount Seir and prophesy against it
verses.literalPt: Filho do homem, dirige o teu rosto contra o monte Seir, e profetiza contra ele.

verses.original: וְאָמַ֣רְתָּ לּ֗וֹ כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה הִנְנִ֥י אֵלֶ֖יךָ הַר־ שֵׂעִ֑יר וְנָטִ֤יתִי יָדִי֙ עָלֶ֔יךָ וּנְתַתִּ֖יךָ שְׁמָמָ֥ה וּמְשַׁמָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mar·tā lōw kōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh hin·nî ’ê·le·ḵā har- śê·‘îr wə·nā·ṭî·ṯî yā·ḏî ‘ā·le·ḵā ū·nə·ṯat·tî·ḵā šə·mā·māh ū·mə·šam·māh
verses.literal: and declare . . . that this is what the Lord GOD says Behold I am against you O Mount Seir I will stretch out My hand against you and make you a desolate waste
verses.literalPt: E dize-lhe: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eis que eu estou contra ti, ó monte Seir, e estenderei a minha mão contra ti, e te farei maior desolação.

verses.original: עָרֶ֙יךָ֙ חָרְבָּ֣ה אָשִׂ֔ים וְאַתָּ֖ה שְׁמָמָ֣ה תִֽהְיֶ֑ה וְיָדַעְתָּ֖ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·re·ḵā ḥā·rə·bāh ’ā·śîm wə·’at·tāh šə·mā·māh ṯih·yeh wə·yā·ḏa‘·tā kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: I will turn your cities into ruins and you will become a desolation Then you will know that I am the LORD
verses.literalPt: As tuas cidades farei desertas, e tu serás desolado; e saberás que eu sou o SENHOR.

verses.original: יַ֗עַן הֱי֤וֹת לְךָ֙ אֵיבַ֣ת עוֹלָ֔ם וַתַּגֵּ֥ר אֶת־ בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עַל־ יְדֵי־ חָ֑רֶב בְּעֵ֣ת אֵידָ֔ם בְּעֵ֖ת עֲוֺ֥ן קֵֽץ׃
verses.transliteration: ya·‘an hĕ·yō·wṯ lə·ḵā ’ê·ḇaṯ ‘ō·w·lām wat·tag·gêr ’eṯ- bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ‘al- yə·ḏê- ḥā·reḇ bə·‘êṯ ’ê·ḏām bə·‘êṯ ‘ă·wōn qêṣ
verses.literal: Because you harbored an ancient hatred and delivered the Israelites . . . over to . . . the sword in the time of their disaster at the final stage . . . of their punishment
verses.literalPt: Porquanto guardaste inimizade perpétua, e espalhaste os filhos de Israel pelo poder da espada no tempo da sua calamidade e no tempo da iniqüidade final.

verses.original: לָכֵ֣ן חַי־ אָ֗נִי נְאֻם֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה כִּֽי־ לְדָ֥ם אֶעֶשְׂךָ֖ וְדָ֣ם יִרְדֲּפֶ֑ךָ אִם־ לֹ֥א דָ֛ם שָׂנֵ֖אתָ וְדָ֥ם יִרְדֲּפֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên ḥay- ’ā·nî nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh kî- lə·ḏām ’e·‘eś·ḵā wə·ḏām yir·dă·p̄e·ḵā ’im- lō ḏām śā·nê·ṯā wə·ḏām yir·dă·p̄e·ḵā
verses.literal: therefore as surely as I live declares the Lord GOD I will give you over to bloodshed and it will pursue you Since you did not hate bloodshed it will pursue you
verses.literalPt: Por isso vivo eu, diz o Senhor DEUS, que te preparei para sangue, e o sangue te perseguirá; visto que não odiaste o sangue, o sangue te perseguirá.

verses.original: וְנָֽתַתִּי֙ אֶת־ הַ֣ר שֵׂעִ֔יר לְשִֽׁמְמָ֖ה וּשְׁמָמָ֑ה וְהִכְרַתִּ֥י מִמֶּ֖נּוּ עֹבֵ֥ר וָשָֽׁב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tî ’eṯ- har śê·‘îr lə·šim·māh ū·šə·mā·māh wə·hiḵ·rat·tî mim·men·nū ‘ō·ḇêr wā·šāḇ
verses.literal: I will make Mount Seir a desolate waste and will cut off from it those who come and go
verses.literalPt: E farei do monte Seir uma extrema desolação, e exterminarei dele o que por ele passar, e o que por ele voltar.

verses.original: וּמִלֵּאתִ֥י אֶת־ הָרָ֖יו חֲלָלָ֑יו גִּבְעוֹתֶ֤יךָ וְגֵאוֹתֶ֙יךָ֙ וְכָל־ אֲפִיקֶ֔יךָ חַלְלֵי־ חֶ֖רֶב יִפְּל֥וּ בָהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mil·lê·ṯî ’eṯ- hā·rāw ḥă·lā·lāw giḇ·‘ō·w·ṯe·ḵā wə·ḡê·’ō·w·ṯe·ḵā wə·ḵāl ’ă·p̄î·qe·ḵā ḥal·lê- ḥe·reḇ yip·pə·lū ḇā·hem
verses.literal: I will fill its mountains with the slain those killed by the sword will fall on your hills in your valleys and in all your ravines
verses.literalPt: E encherei os seus montes dos seus mortos; nos teus outeiros, e nos teus vales, e em todos os teus rios cairão os mortos à espada.

verses.original: שִֽׁמְמ֤וֹת עוֹלָם֙ אֶתֶּנְךָ֔ וְעָרֶ֖יךָ לֹ֣א תֵישַׁבְנָה וִֽידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: šim·mō·wṯ ‘ō·w·lām ’et·ten·ḵā wə·‘ā·re·ḵā lō ṯē·šaḇ·nå̄h wî·ḏa‘·tem kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: I will make you a perpetual desolation and your cities will not be inhabited Then you will know that I am the LORD
verses.literalPt: Em desolações perpétuas te porei, e as tuas cidades nunca mais serão habitadas; assim sabereis que eu sou o SENHOR.

verses.original: יַ֣עַן אֲ֠מָרְךָ אֶת־ שְׁנֵ֨י הַגּוֹיִ֜ם וְאֶת־ שְׁתֵּ֧י הָאֲרָצ֛וֹת לִ֥י תִהְיֶ֖ינָה וִֽירַשְׁנ֑וּהָ וַֽיהוָ֖ה שָׁ֥ם הָיָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ya·‘an ’ă·mā·rə·ḵā ’eṯ- šə·nê hag·gō·w·yim wə·’eṯ- šə·tê hā·’ă·rā·ṣō·wṯ lî ṯih·ye·nāh wî·raš·nū·hā Yah·weh šām hā·yāh
verses.literal: Because you have said These two nations and countries will be ours and we will possess them even though the LORD was there
verses.literalPt: Porquanto disseste: As duas nações e as duas terras serão minhas, e as possuiremos, sendo que o SENHOR se achava ali.

verses.original: לָכֵ֣ן חַי־ אָ֗נִי נְאֻם֮ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִה֒ וְעָשִׂ֗יתִי כְּאַפְּךָ֙ וּכְקִנְאָ֣תְךָ֔ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֔יתָה מִשִּׂנְאָתֶ֖יךָ בָּ֑ם וְנוֹדַ֥עְתִּי בָ֖ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר אֶשְׁפְּטֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên ḥay- ’ā·nî nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh wə·‘ā·śî·ṯî kə·’ap·pə·ḵā ū·ḵə·qin·’ā·ṯə·ḵā ’ă·šer ‘ā·śî·ṯāh miś·śin·’ā·ṯe·ḵā bām wə·nō·w·ḏa‘·tî ḇām ka·’ă·šer ’eš·pə·ṭe·ḵā
verses.literal: therefore as surely as I live declares the Lord GOD I will treat you according to the anger and jealousy you showed in your hatred against them and I will make Myself known among them when I judge you
verses.literalPt: Portanto, vivo eu, diz o Senhor DEUS, que procederei conforme a tua ira, e conforme a tua inveja, de que usaste, no teu ódio contra eles; e me farei conhecer entre eles, quando te julgar.

verses.original: וְֽיָדַעְתָּ֮ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָה֒ שָׁמַ֣עְתִּי׀ אֶת־ כָּל־ נָאָֽצוֹתֶ֗יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָמַ֛רְתָּ עַל־ הָרֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֣ר׀ שָׁמֵמָה לָ֥נוּ נִתְּנ֖וּ לְאָכְלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·ḏa‘·tā kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh šā·ma‘·tî ’eṯ- kāl- nā·’ā·ṣō·w·ṯe·ḵā ’ă·šer ’ā·mar·tā ‘al- hā·rê yiś·rā·’êl lê·mōr šå̄·mē·må̄h lā·nū nit·tə·nū lə·’āḵ·lāh
verses.literal: Then you will know that I the LORD have heard every contemptuous word you uttered against the mountains of Israel when you said They are desolate they are given to us to devour
verses.literalPt: E saberás que eu, o SENHOR, ouvi todas as tuas blasfêmias, que proferiste contra os montes de Israel, dizendo: Já estão assolados, a nós nos são entregues por pasto.

verses.original: וַתַּגְדִּ֤ילוּ עָלַי֙ בְּפִיכֶ֔ם וְהַעְתַּרְתֶּ֥ם עָלַ֖י דִּבְרֵיכֶ֑ם אֲנִ֖י שָׁמָֽעְתִּי׃ס
verses.literal: You boasted against Me with your mouth and multiplied your words against Me I heard it Myself
verses.literalPt: Assim vos engrandecestes contra mim com a vossa boca, e multiplicastes as vossas palavras contra mim. Eu o ouvi.

verses.original: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה כִּשְׂמֹ֙חַ֙ כָּל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ שְׁמָמָ֖ה אֶעֱשֶׂה־ לָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh kiś·mō·aḥ kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ šə·mā·māh ’e·‘ĕ·śeh- lāḵ
verses.literal: This is what the Lord GOD says While the whole earth rejoices I will make you desolate
verses.literalPt: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Quando toda a terra se alegrar eu te porei em desolação.

verses.original: כְּשִׂמְחָ֨תְךָ֜ לְנַחְלַ֧ת בֵּֽית־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל עַ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁמֵ֖מָה כֵּ֣ן אֶעֱשֶׂה־ לָּ֑ךְ שְׁמָמָ֨ה תִֽהְיֶ֤ה הַר־ שֵׂעִיר֙ וְכָל־ אֱד֣וֹם כֻּלָּ֔הּ וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: kə·śim·ḥā·ṯə·ḵā lə·naḥ·laṯ bêṯ- yiś·rā·’êl ‘al ’ă·šer- šā·mê·māh kên ’e·‘ĕ·śeh- lāḵ šə·mā·māh ṯih·yeh har- śê·‘îr wə·ḵāl ’ĕ·ḏō·wm kul·lāh wə·yā·ḏə·‘ū kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: As you rejoiced when the inheritance of the house of Israel - became desolate so will I do to you You will become a desolation O Mount Seir and so will all of Edom Then they will know that I am the LORD
verses.literalPt: Como te alegraste da herança da casa de Israel, porque foi assolada, assim te farei a ti; assolado serás, ó monte Seir, e todo o Edom, sim, todo ele; e saberão que eu sou o SENHOR.
